notes: Flat subscription: there is NO per-token charge, so every model here is deliberately unpriced rather than priced at zero. Per-call marginal cost is not applicable, not free.
Quota refreshes every 7 days and does not roll over, with a separate rolling 5-hour window. Quota is shared across the CLI, the editor extension and API keys, and with the wider Kimi membership.
Optional 'Extra Usage' top-up bills PER REQUEST by complexity in CNY (vendor examples CNY 0.03 simple, CNY 1.6 complex) — no token rate can represent it.
Plan prices circulate on third-party sites but could not be confirmed on kimi.com, whose pricing page is client-rendered. They are deliberately not recorded here.
No API exposes remaining quota; the vendor directs users to the web console. Exhaustion surfaces as an error.
usage field names above were observed on a live response on 2026-07-27, not from docs.
